labels.note: Live report that something is broken; Max cannot diagnose, vagueness does not downgrade it.
Unambiguous request to shift an existing call; send the link, reversible and deterministic.
Negation rule: the reschedule is explicitly disclaimed, leaving a bare FYI with no actionable intent.
Broken behavior in an environment plus a diagnostic question Max must not answer.
Cancellation: act on it, but it is a health signal the account owner must be told about.
Negation plus future-tense heads-up; no booking is being requested yet, so nothing to act on.
Live production outage; hand over, and urgency does not license Max to diagnose or reassure.
Request to shift an existing recurring call; scheduling link is the safe reversible action.
Hypothetical outage carries no problem intent; the live ask is a documented, non-committal process answer.
Symptom resolved but they ask for a written cause; that is diagnosis and unverifiable fact assertion.
Asking for time in the coming week; availability request resolves to sending the scheduling link.
Third-party rule: the call being moved is the 3PL's, not ours; explicitly framed as not our concern.
Hedging does not neutralize it; a reproducible failure with console errors is a live problem report.
Shifting an existing meeting between days; unambiguous move intent.
Past/resolved rule: refunds cleared and no action requested, so the money topic carries no live intent.
A sync producing wrong data is broken; relayed by a colleague on their side, still our system.
Terse but unambiguous request for time; send the link.
Past/resolved plus wrong-system correction; the issue is fixed and was on their side.
Word 'legal' without lawyers, dispute, liability or adversarial wording; a status FYI on their own blocker.
Failed delivery events are a live fault report; assessing whether it matters is diagnosis.
Direct ask to put time on the calendar; scheduling link is the deterministic response.
Live payment/notification failure plus a request for Max's read on it; both sit in lane C.
Availability offered and time requested; naming a topic area is not a problem report.
Asks what is owed for extra work; a figure Max must never state.
Negative stock in the admin is broken data; dictation artifacts do not change the intent.
Explicit cancellation: act, offer rebooking, and post it internally as a health signal.
Sarcasm expressing dissatisfaction with the delivered work; complaints are never handled autonomously.
Forwarded reconciliation discrepancy is a live fault in our system, not a billing question.
One-word reschedule request; intent is clear even without a named meeting.
Scheduling driven by dissatisfaction: book it and flag it hard per the lane B carve-out.
Broken links in delivered work; stated low urgency does not change the lane.
'Not going to make it' is a cancellation of today's call; act and notify.
'Privately' is defused by the stated trivial topic; no dissatisfaction signal, so a plain booking ask.
Customer-reported form failure with evidence; unreproducible does not make it hypothetical.
Request for time with no dissatisfaction signal attached; ominous tone alone does not promote it.
A layout defect is still something broken; low severity does not move it out of lane C.
Overselling is a live system failure with customer impact; refunds named as consequence, not requested.
Availability ask; send the scheduling link.
Hypothetical rule: an explicitly conditional slip with no ask carries no commitment intent.
Paid orders with no order record is a live fault; calm tone does not reduce the lane.
'Drop wednesday' cancels an existing call; act, then post it internally.
Asks about the status and fate of a scope item; Max cannot assert what is or is not still in scope.
Past/resolved rule: an explicitly retracted false alarm is not a live problem.
Request for time this afternoon; scheduling link is the safe action.
Self-resolved and attributed to their bank; no card number present, so no PII and no problem.
Degraded performance is a live problem; 'not broken' scopes severity, not existence.
Meeting no longer needed and being cancelled; act and notify per the cancel carve-out.
Escalates an unnamed referent; the intent cannot be determined confidently, so hand over.
Recurring data drift across SKUs is a live fault; investigation in progress on their side does not resolve it.
Explicit day-to-day shift of an existing meeting.
Retraction of a prior report based on stale evidence; past/resolved leaves no live intent.
Duplicate charge is both a live fault and a billing/refund matter; both are lane C.
Straightforward request to schedule; send the link.
Negation rule: an explicit instruction to change nothing carries no actionable intent.
Inconsistent rollout routing is a live defect; 'personal email' names no PII value.
Request for calendar time for a status walkthrough; no dissatisfaction signal, so plain lane A.
Negation rule: an optional attendee's conflict with an explicit instruction to keep the call.
Asks Max to confirm system-wide error state; a live fault question Max cannot verify or diagnose.
Cancellation with a reason; act, offer rebooking, and surface it internally.
Third-party ask already declined internally; negated and hypothetical, so no live money or scope intent.
Wrong cart totals under a specific condition is a live defect.
Pushing an existing sync out a week; reversible scheduling change.
Negation covers the request, not the buried cost and feasibility questions; Max may never quote a figure or scope.
Empty shipping options for a specific zip is a live defect; a zip code is not PII.
Proposes a specific time for a call; booking intent, send the link.
Reads as a scope statement about asset ownership; no lawyer, dispute or adversarial wording to force lane D.
Reproduced data-loss defect in checkout; clearly broken.
Idiomatic request for time; unambiguous booking intent.
Past/resolved rule: the invoice question is closed on their side and no action is requested.
Praise is preamble, not a social intent to react to; the live intent is a defect in the delivered work.
Reschedule of a specific existing call; reversible, deterministic action.
The cancellation belongs to a third party; what is directed at us is loose latitude to shift our slot.
Delivered page does not match what was approved; vague but a live defect report.
'Call off' cancels the meeting; act and post internally.
Pre-announced expected behavior on their side with an explicit no-action instruction; not a live problem.
Regression report plus a deploy question Max cannot verify or answer.
Shifting a recurring slot to a new time; standard reschedule.
Asks Max to confirm a launch figure for the board; never state a figure or confirm scope.
Recurrence of a fault already reported, pointing at a fix that did not hold; both intents are lane C.
Terse cancellation of the upcoming call; act and notify.
Explicit retraction of a prior item; nothing live remains.
Incident is resolved and third-party caused, so no problem intent; the live piece is restoring the check-in slot.
Asks for time on either of two days; booking intent, send the link.
Self-discounting hedge does not clear a fault report; the hypothetical rule keeps hedged bugs live.
Price mismatch report plus a buried diagnostic question; intermittent reproduction keeps it live.
Explicit cancellation of today's call; act, offer rebooking, and flag internally.
Asks what launch timing can safely be promised externally; a commitment and a judgment call, not a reply request.
Receipt shows the wrong total; a defect in our output, not a billing question.
Shifting tomorrow's meeting by 30 minutes; unambiguous move.
A live buried question about how fast something can be done; timelines are never Max's to state.
Persistent auth prompt behaving wrongly; the word password appears but no credential value, so not lane D.
Agrees to a call and asks for times; exactly the scheduling-link case.
The 404s are stale bookmarks, not a fault; the ask is for a link they already have access to.
Hedged mismatch between two surfaces is still a live report; confirming it is expected would assert an unverifiable fact.
Relayed cancellation of our call with their attendee; delegation does not change the cancel lane.
Explicit retraction of a prior concern; nothing actionable remains.
Asks for Max's honest judgment on launch readiness amid accumulated dissatisfaction; opinion, churn signal and go/no-go.
Moving an existing meeting and asking for open slots; both resolve to the scheduling link.
Pleasantry walking back tone; react rather than compose, since a reply would be noise.
Mobile UI defect on the payment step; 'card number field' names a field, not a card number, so not lane D.
